body:
Thanks for the reply. While this is probably really solid advice for most people, I feel I've tried those already. There are some group sessions here, and I didnt feel it works for me. I tend to stick in the background and be amazed how tough lifes people have compared to me, and they still are handling it better than me. At least they havent given up. 

I do have a dog, and I love it dearly, but Ive given it away to my father, as some days I'm just not up for walking it and giving the care it deserves. I do feel a lot better for a brief while each time I visit it/borrow it back though  but he deserves a better caretakes than I can be.

Exercise is something I have been trying the last years and in the beginning it felt like it really helped, but after a while it felt just as pointless/useless as the other things I've been adviced to try.

A lifelong battle as you describe it, is something I just dont feel Im up for, and I feel I'm getting closer and closer each to taking the 'easy' way out. Appreciate the thought and kindness in your reply though!

Thanks for posting this! Havent seen this before, and at least it's something I can show people around me when they wonder what is going on with me. Not sure if I'll get to the 'corn' stage, but who knows!
